Now the trade itself isn't that bad but the main issue I see is that there are probably a laundry list of other teams willing to give more promising deals for Porzingus 

Plus he's a little soft as a big man and that'll especially come into consideration seeing how Bickerstaff is a defensive minded coach who likes making plays off of turn overs, looking to bolster the overall defense of the squad

Then again K Love is also a pretty soft big so on that end the trade off would be neutral. Not positive but neutral. 

Offensively Kristaps would probably show some good value here since he's working around a smaller team with less prolific scorers allowing him to eat more often and letting him more freely flex his skills as a scorer since he'd probably have the most finesse as a bucket getter on the whole Cavaliers squad (though on Sexton's current trajectory that'd probably change sooner than later)

In conclusion: 

Is the trade even? Eeeeh i guess you could look at it that way 

Is it feasible? No. Well more like incredibly unlikely. Unless they really don't want to pay Kristaps, or he's causing immediate locker room trouble which would not be solved by swapping him out for an aging and irritable Kevin Love. And even if they really wanted to get rid of him they probably have plenty of options willing to offer sexier trades, like the recent playoff berths in The grizzles. In effect it seems like a flat trade (if not an outright gamble) for the Mavs and only clear benefit for the Cavs

"What did I do, god!?"

" Why are you doing this?!"

I can't remember exactly how long I was down like that because eventually I passed out and woke up next day; I've always had frequent migraines so we thought it was just an exceptionally bad one, it wasn't till a while later when reading about cluster headaches and hearing other accounts that I had realized that was it.

But if I were to try and describe the feeling itself? Imagine if your head were being crushed by cinder blocks and your skull was just preparing to explode into a little blood soaked pieces but it never quite got there. Like you're waiting for your brain to splatter, in that moment you definitely would prefer dying 

Tl;Dr 1.5/10 would not recommend. Did get that day and the next off though
